capabilities: Highlight code blocks with Shiki themes, line numbers, and per-block options
Run code blocks in Python, JavaScript, R, Bash, C/C++, and other local interpreters with streaming output
Share variables across blocks and substitute them inline in prose
Render Matplotlib and Plotly figures below code blocks
Import and export Jupyter notebooks and export notes to styled HTML or PDF with outputs
extras: Code execution, Jupyter import/export, and HTML/PDF export are desktop-only; mobile gets highlighting and styling only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Known limitation: the active-line highlight bleeds into code blocks in editor modes.
problem: Obsidian renders code blocks as static text, so running code or keeping notebook-style state means leaving the app for a terminal or Jupyter.

relations.evidence: Jupyter import/export | Convert .ipynb notebooks to/from notes

requires.name: locally installed interpreters (python3, node, gcc, etc.)

summary: Code-block notebook plugin that highlights code with Shiki, runs many languages with streaming output, shares variables across blocks, and renders inline plots.
